Dear John,

I hope this message finds you well. Please find attached the minutes from our recent client meeting held on May 5, 2024. Here is a brief summary:

- We discussed your requirements for the new project and agreed on the project timeline and key milestones.
- We reviewed the initial design concepts and gathered your valuable feedback.

Action Items:
- I will update the project plan based on your feedback.
- David will coordinate with the development team to start the initial phase.

Please note that our next meeting is scheduled for 2024-06-01.

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
